record.reason: MARO processes time-series patches from most recent to oldest with a shared recurrent module and evaluates forecasting benchmarks/ablations. It improves forecasting without increasing parameters with longer history, but is not an LLM reasoning/inference method; the linked recurrent-depth reasoning paper is a superficial architectural analogy.
record.title: Most-Recent Anchoring with Recurrent Ordering for Time Series Forecasting
